comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for XDuck (9-knob). Cross-sidechain ducker / gate: the R channel's level drives the gain of L and the L channel's level drives R. Plug the instrument into IN L and the control signal (drum machine, kick, loop) into IN R. Put XDuck first in the patch so the key reaches it unprocessed: XProbe showed the raw input buffer ctx[4] carries only L (its R half is silent), so a raw-R key is not available. Params arrive as UI*0.01 (LineSel clones), so every knob keeps max <= 100. Page 1 holds the mode controls (the ones changed most).
gid_comment: 0x01 = Dynamics category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DYN_ (user's request 2026-10-19; was 0x08 Delay).
fxid_comment: 0x1f5. Changed 2026-10-19 (was 486, which collides with matujuice's Choral/EuGate). Free in stock, themanro dist and matujuice dist.
fxid_version_comment: Bump on every pedal build. Not drawn on the pedal screen (user's request); shown under the Effect Manager preview. History: C:\zoom\zdlnew\XDuck_versions.txt.

params.name: Type
params.comment: 0 Duck (key loud -> target quieter), 1 Gate (key loud -> target opens), 2 Tex (texture: the target's level follows the key's envelope continuously, dB for dB at Ratio 100, like a one-band vocoder; both outputs carry the mono sum of the two processed channels).

params.name: Route
params.comment: 0 X: R keys L and L keys R. 1 R>L: R keys L, R passes. 2 R<L: L keys R, L passes. 3 KeyR: R keys L, R output silent (R is only the key). 4 KeyL: L keys R, L output silent (L is only the key). With Type=Tex the two outputs are summed to both sides. 5 sForm: R carries sForm's LFO (sForm right before XDuck, Out=XDuck); the gain of L follows it sample by sample, no envelope or smoothing. Duck = 1-LFO, Tex = LFO, Gate = ramp around Thresh (30 = mid-wave) with Ratio as steepness (0 follows the wave, 100 hard); floor -Range dB. Attack/Hold/Release/Freq unused; processed L on both outputs. 6 sFPan: as sForm, but the R output follows the LFO 180 degrees later (auto-pan of L).

params.name: Freq
params.comment: Key band-pass (what the detector listens to). 0 Full = no filter; 1..13 = centre 40 Hz .. 8 kHz in equal ratio steps (x1.555): 40,60,100,150,230,360,570,880,1.4k,2.1k,3.3k,5.1k,8k.

params.name: Thresh
params.comment: Key threshold in dB below full scale: 40 = -40 dB. Higher = reacts to quieter key.

params.name: Range
params.comment: Maximum gain reduction in dB (duck depth / gate floor).

params.name: Ratio
params.comment: Duck: compression slope, 100 = limiter (inf:1). Gate: expander steepness, 100 = hard gate.

params.name: Attack
params.comment: 0.1 ms .. 100 ms, exponential. Duck: how fast it ducks. Gate: how fast it opens.

params.name: Hold
params.comment: 0 .. 500 ms, linear. The key level is held this long after it falls: duck stays down, gate stays open.

params.name: Release
params.comment: 5 ms .. 2.5 s, exponential. Duck: recovery (the pump). Gate: how fast it closes.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
